name: humanizer-pro
description: Finds the habits that make text read as machine-written, flags leftover chatbot text, and checks that a rewrite kept every fact. Local, no API key.

plugins.name: humanizer-pro
plugins.description: Use when editing, reviewing, or self-auditing text to remove signs of AI writing and make it read as human: "humanize this," de-slop a draft, "sounds too AI," "check this," "score this," "audit only," "AI check," "do not rewrite," style edit, Elements of Style pass, wiki or Wikipedia-style article draft or rewrite, neutral tone, wikitext, citations, source-bound writing, or cleaning up chatbot residue.
